# StableStateLandscape

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The multi-dimensional configuration space of all possible stable equilibria in a complex ecosystem, whose topology determines system resilience and transitions. Offers a framework for mapping computational state spaces in iNEST, enabling prediction of memory or attractor dynamics in neuromorphic substrates.
